
Release Procedure
=================

Source Code
___________

Compile cyboi using "make cyboi"
Test cybol applications, e.g. "../src/controller/cyboi counter/simple/run.cybol"
Analyse code using tools "valgrind" and "cppcheck"

Administrative Data
___________________

Adapt version constant "VERSION_IDENTIFICATION_CYBOI_MODEL" in file "identification_cyboi_model.c"
Adapt shell script "adjust_version.sh" manually
Run shell script "adjust_version.sh" in order to replace copyright year as well as version and date
Adapt directories, files, version in file "build/cmake/packaging.cmake"
Build project using "make clean" and "make"
Update files in directory "todo/"
Update ChangeLog
Update AUTHORS reading ChangeLog entries
Update NEWS subsumpting ChangeLog entries
Commit SVN
Tag SVN
Create tarball using "cpack"
Create GPG binary signature for tarball file
Upload tarball file to Savannah

API
___

Update api to latest functionality (logic and states)

Website
_______

Create new file for release in www/cybop/plan/
Copy content from NEWS to www/cybop/plan/cybop-x.x.x.html
Update www/cybop/plan/index.html
Update www/cybop/news.html
Update www/cybop/index.html
Update www/cybop/footer.inc
Upload website

Announcement
____________

Announce release in mailing list
